from fractions import Fraction as F
import json

bars = 1500
cost = F(bars, 8) * 3                # 8 bars cost $3
bundles, rem = divmod(bars, 20)      # 20 bars sold together for $12
bundle_rev = F(bundles) * 12
rem_rev = F(rem, 3) * 2              # leftover bars at 3 for $2
revenue = bundle_rev + rem_rev
profit = revenue - cost

alt_rev_3for2 = F(bars, 3) * 2       # all bars at 3 for $2, for comparison
choices = {"A": 325, "B": F(675, 2), "C": 350, "D": 375, "E": 400}
letter = [k for k, v in choices.items() if v == profit]

print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": str(float(profit)) if letter else "UNSUPPORTED",
    "choice": letter[0] if letter else None,
    "evidence": {
        "cost": str(cost),
        "bundles_of_20": bundles,
        "leftover_bars": rem,
        "revenue_bundled": str(revenue),
        "revenue_if_3for2_only": str(alt_rev_3for2),
        "profit": str(profit),
    },
}))
